visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark shoulder-length hair and two white hair clips is holding a small white dog and a pink mascara brush. She is wearing a purple v-neck sweater. The background is a plain white wall. (2) A close-up shot shows hands using metal tweezers to pull the pink bristles off the mascara brush, leaving only the twisted metal core. (3) The woman bends the metal wire core of the brush into a semi-circular shape to match the contour of an eye. (4) A lighter is used to heat the curved metal wire. A text overlay says '加熱!' (Heat!). (5) Extreme close-ups show the woman's eyelashes from the side, labeled as 'before' to show their natural state. (6) The woman carefully brings the heated metal wire to her upper eyelashes, pressing upwards to curl them. A warning text about minors appears. (7) High-resolution side profile shots of her eye are shown, labeled 'After', displaying noticeably curled lashes. (8) The woman shows her hand to the camera, pointing out black soot or residue on her fingers caused by the heated metal. (9) She returns to the main frame, holding the DIY tool and speaking directly to the viewer with a warning expression.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a DIY beauty experiment testing a viral social media hack for curling eyelashes using a stripped mascara brush heated with a lighter. The creator demonstrates the steps, compares results (before/after), and ultimately warns viewers about the risks such as heat and soot residue.
